about.about_me_desc: I am a motivated Front-End Developer with strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and hands-on experience using Angular to build responsive, user-friendly web applications. I have a solid understanding of object-oriented programming, web services (REST, JSON), and version control tools like Git. Passionate about clean code, continuous learning, and contributing to agile development teams.

experience.work_1_desc_2: Developing end-to-end frontend features using reusable components, typed REST API integration, routing, and state management.
experience.work_1_desc_3: Collaborating with backend developers and reviewers to resolve production issues and maintain clean, consistent code.
experience.work_2_desc_1: Worked with existing Angular codebases and learned reusable component patterns and team development conventions.
experience.work_2_desc_2: Contributed to real-world frontend features under mentorship.

experience.training_1_desc_3: Worked with Angular Libraries, NgRx, NgRx Signals, and Module Federation for state management and modular application development.

experience.training_2_desc_2: Supported team projects by applying modern frontend practices.
